text.text_excerpt: This place serves the most authentic Thai food in town. The dishes and flavors are not water down; they are real! My friend and I sat at the bar and we were able to order food and drink at the bar and dang, the prices were so reasonable. The best part we're all the yummy authentic Thai flavors! We had the pork dumplings to start with and both the filling and wrapper were perfectly tender and flavorful. Then came the papaya salad Issan style which had a tangy crab flavor to it and was spicy good! Next we had the Tom Yum shrimp soup and that was just hearty and delightful. Finally got the chance to take the short walk over to Budsi's for dinner tonight. Everything about this great little neighborhood Thai treasure met or exceeded my expectations. The comfortable sidewalk seating, with classy fire heaters beckoned me from down the block. The cool interior space felt so welcoming. The menu tempted me to order way more than I needed. Finally, over a delicious gin cocktail, called the south side, expertly crafted by Charlie, I decided on the dishes I couldn't resist. The Tom kah soup was perfect. The pork dumplings were awesome. I have been looking forward to trying Budsi's since their restaurant opened, and I was far from disappointed! There is a great casual vibe, and a good amount of outdoor seating too. You order food at the counter and drinks separately at the bar. I ordered the Spicy Som Tam and Grilled Pork Shoulder Set, while my friend had the Khao Soi. The som tam papaya salad was fresh, crunchy, and complimented the tender and perfectly grilled pork well. You can also choose from 2 options for the som tam: Upcountry or Bangkok style.
